key.name: share-guard
key.description: While the whole screen is shared, the windows of the apps in share-guard-apps (and Files windows in the Private folder) are covered: blurred, or with a solid card. Covered as soon as a share starts; uncovered once every stream is known to be a single window.

key.name: share-guard-apps
key.summary: Apps covered while the screen is shared

key.name: share-guard-private
key.description: Files windows showing a place inside ~/Private are covered while the screen is shared.

key.name: shield
key.description: What the protection state looks like: a tile in quick settings, a mark in the top bar, the mark only when something needs a look, or nothing. It only shows; every line opens Security.

key.name: network-apps
key.description: The network meter's menu lists the apps with open connections and where to, only while it is open.
